svg.title: How CPython runs a file
svg.desc: Six stages, numbered 1 to 6: source code, lexer, parser, syntax tree (AST), bytecode compiler, interpreter loop. Arrows run from 1 to 3 along the top row, down to 4, then back along the bottom row to 6. A shaded region tagged A covers stages 1 to 5, the compilation phase; a region tagged B covers stage 6, the runtime phase.
